data.desc: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MDGL) is a biopharmaceutical company leading the fight against metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a liver disease with high unmet medical need. Madrigal has an approved therapy for MASH and a pipeline of investigational candidates targeting multiple pathways involved in liver disease progression. Through continued investment in innovation, Madrigal is committed to helping shape the future of MASH care and improving outcomes for patients.
